meta.name: DUMMIES story: the Test City, tile by tile
meta.status: Narrative A, Certified, under the lore refinement of GDD Edit 95 (user-decided, 29 October): Dummy Corporation narrates; Farsight, the publisher, is named only in the Credits. Edit 96: tales up to 35 words. Text from style run 20261029-172610-v81 on Style Guide V2; gameplay fields as story.json (edit93)
sources: GDD Edit 95: lore refinement, Dummy Corporation
rules: Numbers live in the registry: tasks and gifts name parameter IDs, never values.
A task tests the hit that writes the chassis off (the fatal hit).
Tile names are column-row, as in the game: A1 is the top-left tile.
Each tile's write-offs are story.writeOffs.<district>.<tile> in the registry (Edit 82).

Edit 93: introduce, then test. A part arrives on the tile whose brief first needs it; no brief needs a part not yet issued. Monument: Battery 1 B1 (dash), Hands 1 A2 (cone), Legs 1 B3 (jump). Parkland: Arms 1 C1 (push), Legs 2 A3 (jump), Hands 2 A2 (cone), Arms 2 A1 (push), Battery 2 B2 (combo). Waterfront: Legs 3 B1 (jump), Arms 3 B3 (push), Battery 3 B2 (combo).
A gift rides in on the drone that carries the dummy into its tile (Edit 84). Arcade sells every part for credits; its chassis ships with Battery 1 (Edit 91).
Each tile's traffic is story.traffic.<district>.<tile> in the registry, on the tile and its neighbours (Edit 85).
Edit 92: Narrative A, Certified. Act I Monument (Induction), Act II Parkland (Opening Day), Act III Waterfront (Customs).

Edit 95: Dummy Corporation narrates: deadpan and inspirational, few adjectives, no exclamation marks. Every text at most two sentences and 20 words (style.v2.text.maxSentences, style.v2.text.maxWords). Farsight is named only in the Credits.
Edit 96: a tale may run to 35 words (style.v2.tale.maxWords); the extra words name the place.

ending: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.

any.label: ANY WRITE-OFF
any.brief: General coverage. Any write-off in this tile counts.

dash.label: DASH INTO A CAR
dash.brief: Coverage gap: dashes. The final hit must be a dash into a car.

drop.label: DROP ONTO A CAR
drop.brief: Coverage gap: falls. The final hit must be a drop onto a car from above.

jump.label: JUMP INTO A CAR
jump.brief: Coverage gap: jumps. The final hit must be a jump into a car.

level.label: ON A RAISED ROAD
level.brief: Coverage gap: raised roads. The final hit must land at Z1 or above.

cone.label: CONE-BAITED CAR
cone.brief: Coverage gap: cones. The final hit must come from a car reacting to a cone.

push.label: PUSH OFF A CAR
push.brief: Coverage gap: ricochets. Push off one car; the final hit must be the next car.

bounce.label: THROWN INTO A CAR
bounce.brief: Coverage gap: rebounds. The final hit must come while a hit is still throwing you.

struck.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING
struck.brief: Coverage gap: pedestrians. The final hit must be a car hitting you while you walk or stand.

combo.label: COMBO ×{n}
combo.brief: Coverage gap: chains. The final hit must be link {n} or later of a combo.

cls.label: A {cls}
cls.brief: Coverage gap: the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.

districts.name: Monument
districts.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.

A1.title: The welcome wall
A1.tale: A conveyor sets you down at the welcome wall, where a screen shows your face and the word WELCOME. Your first duty toward Certification: stand in the road until a colleague notices you.

B1.title: The podium bridge
B1.tale: Battery 1 is fitted, for the dash. Shoppers never came to the podium bridge; staff now watch from it as you dash into a colleague, toward Certification.

C1.title: The LED drum
C1.tale: The LED drum lights each bend so no colleague is surprised. Where the high road breaks its rail over the street, step off onto a car below: gravity is company policy.

C2.title: The portal tower
C2.tale: The raised road passes through the portal tower, above its tenants. Your write-off belongs on that road, at height; Certification does not include the view.

B2.title: The monument
B2.tale: The monument's plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS, a target rather than a record. Stand or walk beside it and let a colleague find you; dashing would spoil the data.

A2.title: The neon shops
A2.tale: The neon shops under the highway sell nothing, yet the traffic reads every sign. Hands 1 is fitted: place a cone, and let a colleague who reads it write you off.

A3.title: The stacked cubes
A3.tale: Each stacked cube was added as the budget arrived, one on the last; we call this growth. Your duty grows the same way: one hit, then another before the first is forgotten.

B3.title: The LED canyon
B3.tale: Legs 1 is fitted. In the LED canyon, two screens advertise across the road all night; jump into a car between them, for our clients.

C3.title: The LED gateway
C3.tale: The LED gateway thanks every car for driving safely, even the one that wrote you off. Your file reads ROLE: DESTRUCTIVE TESTING; let one colleague throw you into the next.

districts.name: Parkland
districts.intro: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.

C1.title: The lantern pavilion
C1.tale: The paper lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit again for our clients. Arms 1 is fitted: under the footbridge, push off one car into the next, and the Expo opens safer.

C2.title: The amphitheatre
C2.tale: Our board will watch from these terraces on opening day, and every crossing of the avenue is a performance. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.

C3.title: The arch and the roundabout
C3.tale: The arch is the Expo's gate; visitors will circle the roundabout once before they enter. Go round faster, and chain your hits before the first is forgotten.

B3.title: The obelisk court
B3.tale: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake; on opening day the police fleet escorts a school party here. Your final hit must come from a police car: the escort is tested on you first.

A3.title: The belvedere
A3.tale: A wedding is booked on the belvedere for opening day, facing the traffic. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car here, so that no guest ever does.

A2.title: The dome by the canal
A2.tale: The dome by the canal is the Expo's showroom, readied for our clients. Hands 2 is fitted: lay a cone, and let the car that answers it write you off.

A1.title: The reservoir terraces
A1.tale: At the reservoir terraces, the gardener tends three pools by hand; she asks that cars stop before the water. Arms 2 is fitted; teach them with a ricochet, one car to the next.

B1.title: The cascade
B1.tale: The cascade steps the reservoir's water down beside the highway, pool by pool, to drown out the traffic. Go up to the highway and take your write-off where the traffic is loudest.

B2.title: The ring over the pools
B2.tale: Battery 2 is fitted: a second charge. The board watches the ring over the pools; carry the chain your brief asks for, and the Expo opens to clients.

districts.name: Waterfront
districts.intro: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.

A1.title: The west portal
A1.tale: Before you cross the river to our clients, we require the bus fleet's data. At the west portal, the bus carries engineers from the upper town to the bridge; stand in its path.

B1.title: The tunnel portal
B1.tale: Legs 3 is fitted for the longest flight. At the tunnel portal, cars go in under the hill and data comes back; jump into one, and your data serves our clients.

C1.title: The east portal
C1.tale: The east bridge was built to correct the west; its portal block faces the other way. The police here check papers, and a police car's final hit moves yours forward.

C2.title: The east beach terrace
C2.tale: From the rail of the east beach terrace, you can see the ships that carry Certified dummies to clients. Drop onto a car below; the ships will wait.

C3.title: The east customs post
C3.tale: The east pier tower is a customs post; it logs every Certified dummy that crosses the river to our clients. Be thrown into a car while a hit still throws you, and earn your entry.

B3.title: The stilt houses
B3.tale: Arms 3 is fitted; push off one car into the next. Behind glass in the stilt houses stands Chassis 0, the prototype before you; show it how far the model has come.

A3.title: The west customs post
A3.tale: At the west customs post, the log lists every dummy bound for clients across the river. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION; honour it on the raised road.

A2.title: The west beach terrace
A2.tale: The west beach terrace was laid with sand from three provinces, for clients you will one day serve. Place a cone and meet the car that reacts to it; every write-off here serves them.

B2.title: The circus
B2.tale: Battery 3 is fitted: complete the chain your brief sets, and you are Certified for our clients. The circus island's monument, cast from every write-off, reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS).
